codex rollout probe: find -newermt relative to dispatch under ~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD returned a false negative once while the rollout existed; verify with pgrep + a direct ls of the session dir before declaring a deadlock.
jit issue claim silently no-ops via tail-swallowed error on dep-blocked issues (they refuse in_progress); use jit issue assign for advisory ownership of blocked issues and verify assignee afterward.

git add .jit sweeps OTHER leads' unstaged gate/issue writes (peer gate evaluations write .jit outside their lock window; incident 692f0653). Under the lock: verify git status --porcelain .jit is clean BEFORE your own jit writes, commit immediately after, and never use commit -am.

codex sandbox_workspace_write.writable_roots=[.git/worktrees/<name>] is NOT enough for worker commits: commits also write .git/objects and refs/heads (shared, read-only to the sandbox). Workers may leave a stale index citing never-written blobs — git reset before git add -A when committing on their behalf.

A `static` inside a generic fn or generic inherent impl is SHARED across all monomorphizations in Rust — a naive once-per-type OnceLock validation cache memoizes the FIRST type's answer for every type (silent wrong-field bug). Verified empirically by worker-0e706bf5. Use a per-instance certificate/memo value instead.

Native subagents inherit the user's global CLAUDE.md, including its delegate-to-codex rule; a hard task assigned to a native model needs an explicit no-delegation clause in the dispatch prompt or the subagent will sub-delegate (R-22 incident).

The unidentified external process-killer now also kills the lead's harness background tasks (three kills in ~15 min: one CI twice, one poller). Mitigation that works: setsid-detached nohup process writing a done-file, watched by a Monitor tool loop that checks the done-file AND process liveness.

The shared cache pool can carry STALE FINGERPRINTS whose artifacts are gone (harvest raced/partial): cargo believes units fresh, skips rebuilds, and E0463 surfaces at a distant consumer (gf2-kernels-hip). Symptom of debug: many conflicting rmeta candidates listed by rustc are the search residue, not the cause. Fix: prune the affected crates' .fingerprint trees AND deps artifacts together in the pool (done for gf2-core/simd/hip/coding, both profiles).
SendMessage teammate reports truncate around ~3KB; long worker reports need chunked retrieval (three round-trips for 230dd84d). Ask workers to lead with actionable items, details after.

A doc fix that scopes a claim to 'current public variants' goes stale one wave later when the next variant lands — write doc claims against the design's END state or name the variant explicitly (37c288cf R1 was the lead's own 230dd84d fix).
